headline: Seduta in prevalenza negativa a Wall Street: AppLovin +31,04% guida i rialzi
headline_en: Broadly negative session on Wall Street: AppLovin +31.04% leads gainers

paragraphs: Nella seduta del 5 novembre 2026 l'S&P 500 ha chiuso con 73 societa' in rialzo, 430 in ribasso, su 503 titoli monitorati. La variazione media dell'indice e' stata di -3,12%.

Settori con la variazione media migliore: Consumer Staples (-0,64%); Utilities (-0,76%); Communication Services (-1,24%). Settori piu' debolli: Information Technology (-7,78%); Industrials (-3,79%); Energy (-3,35%).

In cima alla seduta: AppLovin (APP, +31,04%), dove Barron's riporta: «Why AppLovin and Unity Stocks Are Surging as Tech Falls»; Tapestry, Inc. (TPR, +7,07%), dove Reuters riporta: «Tapestry lifts outlook as young shoppers snap up Coach bags, shares jump»; Verisk Analytics (VRSK, +6,88%). In fondo: Sandisk (SNDK, -22,26%), dove MarketWatch riporta: «Micron, Sandisk and other AI stocks see steep drops: ‘Investors don’t like uncertainty’»; Lumentum (LITE, -18,68%), dove Barron's riporta: «Marvell, Lumentum Stocks Have Lost $91 Billion. Could Their Merger Fall Apart?»; Micron Technology (MU, -17,46%), dove MarketWatch riporta: «Micron, Sandisk and other AI stocks see steep drops: ‘Investors don’t like uncertainty’».

The Nasdaq-100 underperformed significantly, dropping 5.44 percent compared to the broader market, as technology stocks bore the brunt of the retreat. Across the 518 stocks tracked, 441 declined while only 77 advanced, with the Dow Jones closing entirely in the red at all 30 components down and averaging a 3.02 percent loss.

Consumer Staples proved most resilient, declining just 0.58 percent, followed by Utilities at 0.76 percent. The selloff extended to semiconductor and chip-related names, with Micron Technology dropping 17.46 percent, Advanced Micro Devices falling 17.26 percent, and Lam Research sliding 16.36 percent. According to MarketWatch, investor uncertainty over AI implementation timelines and data-center deployment delays weighed heavily on the sector.

AppLovin surged 31.04 percent, bucking the broader tech decline as Barron's reported the stock rising alongside Unity amid the broader tech selloff. Tapestry, Inc. climbed 7.07 percent after Reuters reported the company lifted its outlook as young shoppers increased purchases of Coach bags. Verisk Analytics gained 6.88 percent and Corpay rose 6.78 percent with no specific catalysts cited by tracked outlets. CF Industries advanced 6.17 percent, Albemarle Corporation gained 3.58 percent, and Motorola Solutions climbed 4.03 percent, while Charter Communications, Mosaic Company, and Steris posted more modest gains.

The decline extended across semiconductor and memory stocks, with Sandisk falling 22.26 percent as MarketWatch cited investor concerns over AI uncertainty. Astera Labs dropped 19.62 percent, Lumentum fell 18.68 percent amid concerns over a potential merger with Marvell Technology, and Western Digital declined 17.35 percent. Bloom Energy slid 16.41 percent on fears of data-center delays, while Marvell Technology itself fell 16.43 percent. Verisk Analytics, Corpay, Charter Communications, Mosaic Company, and Steris saw no specific company catalysts reported by tracked outlets for their respective moves.
